scenes.vo: Here's how the Crease Cam app works.
One app for iPhone and Android, built once with Expo.
First, pick a drill. Say, bowling, side view.
The camera opens with a see-through guide. Line up the stumps and the player, then hit record.
Watch it back in slow-mo, frame by frame, and draw lines, like the front arm angle.
Videos stay on your phone. Private, safe for under-eighteens, and nothing gets uploaded.
It's free to start, or three ninety-nine a month, or thirty-nine ninety-nine a year.
The plan: a test version, a club pilot, then payments, then the app stores.
